sources.title: OpenClawdex README.md
sources.finding: The documented install is macOS with an authenticated Claude Code or Codex CLI. Existing Max and ChatGPT logins are supported; threads and inline permissions are the main workflow.

sources.title: OpenClawdex LICENSE
sources.finding: The repository is licensed under MIT, permitting use, modification and redistribution without a license fee. This does not cover provider services.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/package.json
sources.finding: Electron 41.2.0 package 0.6.1 packages macOS DMG and ZIP. React renderer and Electron main process are separate packages.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/main.ts
sources.locator: getOrCreateSession; setupIpcHandlers; createWindow; checkForUpdates; before-quit, lines 73–1501
sources.finding: The main process maps local thread IDs to Claude/Codex sessions, handles renderer IPC, persists local thread metadata, loads harness histories, opens project folders and editors, checks GitHub updates, and closes sessions when the app quits.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/preload.ts
sources.finding: The complete contextBridge exposes local session, project, thread, model, editor and branch operations only. There is no externally exposed API, scheduler, native issue model or shipping API.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/db/schema.ts
sources.finding: SQLite metadata stores projects, project folders and known threads with provider, custom name, context stats, pin/archive fields and ordering. There are no task/issue, user, role, dependency or specification tables.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/db/index.ts
sources.finding: Database initialization uses a file URL under Electron userData, not a hosted database.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/claude.ts
sources.locator: buildCanUseTool 382–419; startQuery 580–622; consumeStream 625–659; resolveRequest, interrupt and close
sources.finding: ClaudeSession launches the installed Claude Code through query, streams text/tools/results, forwards model and effort, resumes a session ID and bridges user questions, plan approvals and tool permissions. Dollar cost and duration come from the SDK result.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/codex.ts
sources.locator: constructor spawn at 254; initialize 941; ensureThreadReady 957; runOneTurn 1048; interrupt 1243; close 1254
sources.finding: CodexSession spawns codex app-server and uses initialize, thread/start or thread/resume, turn/start and turn/interrupt. It serializes inputs per session, handles approvals and temporary image files, and returns null dollar cost and duration.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/user-mode.ts
sources.finding: Permission modes map to Claude SDK gates or Codex approval/sandbox policies. Codex plan uses read-only; ask and acceptEdits use workspace-write; bypass disables approvals and uses danger-full-access. Claude mode persistence cannot distinguish every UI mode from the rollout.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/web/src/components/ChatView.tsx
sources.locator: ChatView; FileChange rendering; model and permission pickers; keyboard handlers
sources.finding: ChatView renders transcripts, tool-summary rows, file-change paths with addition/deletion counts, model/effort and permission controls, queued messages and approval cards. File links open an external editor. The selected FileChangeCard and ToolUseIndicator do not render a code diff.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/web/src/components/PlanApprovalCard.tsx
sources.finding: Plan approval cards show plan text and file links, allow or reject the plan, and bind Escape and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter. A replayed plan is read-only.

sources.title: OpenClawdex apps/desktop/src/codex-history.ts
sources.finding: Codex history is rebuilt from local JSONL rollouts. The reader reconstructs user/assistant/tool/plan records, not a process snapshot or a tamper-proof audit log.

sources.title: OpenClawdex v0.6.1 release
sources.locator: Release body and published_at from the retained releases API response
sources.finding: Public v0.6.1 release dated 2026-04-23 lists pinning, queue interrupt, periodic updates and tool display fixes.
